assets: public and internal certificate private keys

critical_threats.threat: Attacker uses Host or forwarded-header confusion to reach unintended backend
critical_threats.unresolved: Application frameworks may reinterpret normalized headers differently.

critical_threats.threat: Compromised DNS API credential issues certificates or redirects validation
critical_threats.unresolved: Many DNS providers do not support truly subtree-scoped credentials.

critical_threats.threat: Runtime certificate update succeeds in memory but is lost on restart
critical_threats.unresolved: Certificate persistence adapter not yet implemented.
No exception framework exists for replay-safe endpoints.

critical_threats.threat: One transit provider or DDoS event removes all public reachability
critical_threats.unresolved: Project cannot independently absorb internet-scale volumetric attacks.

critical_threats.threat: Proxy admin socket compromise rewrites routing or certificates
critical_threats.unresolved: Root compromise on an edge node still reaches the local proxy.

critical_threats.threat: Internal CA compromise enables backend impersonation
critical_threats.unresolved: Online intermediate compromise remains effective until trust rotation completes.
